sn_aia_usecase.base_plan: 1. Parse the provided meeting transcript to extract all clear action items, assigned owners, and required due dates. 2. Identify dependencies between tasks (for example, if one person must complete a prerequisite step before another can begin). 3. Create a task record in the custom agent tasks table for each extracted action item, mapping the task title, assignee, due date, and dependencies. 4. Format the final output as a clean, human-readable summary table containing the task title, assignee, due date, priority, and dependencies.
sn_aia_usecase.description: Parses meeting transcripts and creates structured task records.
sn_aia_usecase.name: Meeting Intelligence
